3.speaker: Elena Werner
3.text: "This appears to be a list of financial transactions performed by Rizian Royal Gold on behalf of the Lespian government."

4.speaker: Elena Werner
4.text: "However, most of the pertinent details have been blacked out. We know that money was moved, but not to whom or for what purpose."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "It doesn't matter. A traitor's a traitor."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "The Rizian state owns a significant part of RRG. How could we have let this go undetected?"

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "Lespia has lied to us about a great many things. Why not this?"

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "Covering up Lespia's involvement in the Wehlen bombing was a huge favor. This is all we get in return?"

12.speaker: Lucita Azaro
12.text: "Agreed. This document alone is more than enough to put Montoro behind bars."

13.speaker: Titus Gordion
13.text: "The information here is more than enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

17.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
17.text: "I agree. With this evidence, we can put Montoro behind bars and restore RRG's rightful ownership."

18.speaker: Elena Werner
18.text: "A corporation as large as RRG performs thousands of transactions per week. It's not unusual for one or two to fly under the radar."

22.speaker: Lucita Azaro
22.text: "Compromising Rizia's national security right under our nose. The man deserves to rot."

23.speaker: Titus Gordion
23.text: "It's not on par with Duchess Azaro's betrayal. But it's a flagrant breach of national security."

27.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
27.text: "This is an unforgivable security breach, Your Majesty. Our forces should have been more vigilant."

31.speaker: Lucita Azaro
31.text: "This document alone is more than enough to put Montoro behind bars."

32.speaker: Titus Gordion
32.text: "The information here is more than enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

36.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
36.text: "*If* Lespia can be trusted, this document alone is enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

37.speaker: Elena Werner
37.text: "We've verified what little information we could. It all checks out."

38.speaker: Hugo Toras
38.text: "At long last, the time has come."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "On second thought, Rusty has proven himself loyal to the Crown in the past. Perhaps he deserves a second chance."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "I confess I'm curious to hear Rusty's side of the story."

44.speaker: Hugo Toras
44.text: "Montoro's Arcasian guards can't save him now. The time has come to act."

45.speaker: Hugo Toras
45.text: "The fault lies entirely with Mr. Montoro. His Arcasian guards can't save him now. The time has come to act."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I can't say I'm happy about this revelation. But I will enjoy hearing Rusty beg for his life."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "I take no pleasure in this. We had the chance to hold Lespia to account for its wrongdoing, and we gave it up just to reel in a small fish."

48.speaker: Elena Werner
48.text: "If we spare him from arrest, perhaps we can persuade him to hand them over."

49.speaker: Elena Werner
49.text: "Mr. Montoro may well still have access to the original copies of these files, or others that could expose the extent of Lespia's actions against us."

50.speaker: Elena Werner
50.text: "We do have significant leverage over Mr. Montoro now. If we were to spare him from arrest, we would secure his unconditional loyalty."

54.speaker: Hugo Toras
54.text: "I heard that he had a hand in the Rizian National Coalition's election gains. But they would have won just as easily without him."

55.speaker: Hugo Toras
55.text: "The only loyalty I've witnessed from that man is his devotion to hideous cravats."

56.speaker: Elena Werner
56.text: "Whatever he may or may not have done in the past, sparing him from arrest would secure his and RRG's full cooperation in the future."

57.speaker: Elena Werner
57.text: "Perhaps he could even lead us to the uncensored versions of these files."

58.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
58.text: "A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. But now that Prime Minister Alvarez has given us evidence of Rusty's dealings with Lespia, he'll be expecting us to take swift action."

62.speaker: Lucita Azaro
62.text: "Yes, I don't even understand why we're still talking about this. We should imprison Montoro and put his company under state control as soon as possible."

63.speaker: Titus Gordion
63.text: "Swift action is certainly warranted. As is the immediate nationalization of Mr. Montoro's company."

67.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
67.text: "You've hit the nail on the head, Esquibel. We imprison Montoro and put his company under state control. It's as simple as that."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "I agree completely. By order of the king, Russello Montoro is to be placed under immediate arrest."

69.speaker: Sal Ignacius
69.text: "We do not know the circumstances under which this lost soul acted. Forgiving him would surely bring us one step closer to Golconda."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "We won't arrest him yet. I want to see what information we can get out of him first."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "Mr. Montoro is more useful to me outside of prison than in it. We'll hold off on arresting him."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius has spoken the truth. God rewards those who forgive."

82.speaker: Hugo Toras
82.text: "Your Majesty, I am firmly convinced that letting this man walk free is a mistake."

86.speaker: Lucita Azaro

93.speaker: Hugo Toras
93.text: "But does He also not smile when justice is meted out in His name?"

94.speaker: Hugo Toras
94.text: "Even discounting his treachery, Mr. Montoro has made a mockery of everything this kingdom has stood for--"

99.speaker: Titus Gordion
99.text: "Your Grace, I'm afraid the King has spoken."

104.speaker: Lucita Azaro
104.text: "I'll dispatch extra security forces to Bronaz. We'll watch his every move."

118.text: "This information gives us significant leverage against his corporation. Perhaps a light touch is preferable to moving in with brute force."

122.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
122.text: "A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. But more to the point, if we have the chance to trade our intelligence on Mr. Montoro for incriminating details regarding Lespia, we should do it."

126.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
126.text: "Perhaps he could even provide us with more damning evidence of Lespia's past misdeeds."

127.speaker: Elena Werner
127.text: "This appears to be a list referencing payments tied to extensive re-training of former Rizian Royal Gold employees — employees who later secured key roles in our energy sector."

128.speaker: Elena Werner
128.text: "Although most of the pertinent details have been blacked out, we suspect these transactions were performed by Mr. Montoro himself on behalf of the Lespian government."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Such treachery to the Crown must not go unpunished."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "If Lespia has been meddling in Rizia's affairs, they shouldn't be allowed to get away with it."

134.speaker: Lucita Azaro
134.text: "Agreed. But our first step should be to put Mr. Montoro behind bars and restore RRG's rightful ownership."

135.speaker: Titus Gordion
135.text: "Agreed. But our first step should be to put Mr. Montoro behind bars and restore RRG's rightful ownership."

139.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

141.speaker: Hugo Toras
141.text: "On the other hand, if Mr. Montoro doesn't have any useful information, we'll have thrown away our shot at nationalizing his company."

145.speaker: Lucita Azaro
145.text: "Our security forces will keep a close watch on the man, even if we don't arrest him right away."

146.speaker: Titus Gordion

151.text: "But there's always the risk he'll get wind of all this and flee. I suggest we take swift action."
